data.name: In Perfection
data.detailed_description:
"In Perfection" is a psychological visual novel combining surreal narrative and point-and-click adventure. "It is not perfect at all, perfection is impossible." ㅤ "But I think it is perfect enough." ㅤ "You are deceiving yourself." ㅤ "The world itself is a lie." ㅤ "So you just go along with it?" ㅤ ㅤ ㅤ "This is a survival strategy." ㅤ "You are weak and cowardly. That is obvious." ㅤ "And you think highly of yourself only because no one cares about you. Aren't you deceiving yourself too?"

About the Game ㅤ "How can I summarize this game in a few words?"

You are a down-and-out, lonely writer suffering from obsessive-compulsive disorder, "I actively embrace loneliness." ㅤ "I am indeed tormented by loneliness." ㅤ "Write it more warmly, it shouldn't seem so arrogant." ㅤtrying to write "the most perfect work". You examine every word and sentence you write like the most resolute judge, This sentence is a bit hard to read, it needs to be changed. ㅤand even every thought in your mind. But as the writing deepens, you find that the protagonist in the novel, who is also in a poor mental state, is strangely overlapping with your reality. "Yesterday he and I locked eyes in the mirror."

Maintaining Sanity in Distractions ㅤ "Sanity is a lie."

Writing absolutely must not be disturbed. However, accidents keep happening. Pick up the tools around you and deal with the accidents through intuitive point-and-click interactions. The word order here needs adjusting. ㅤHowever, seemingly ordinary little things will also trigger questioning of existence and life. Forgive yourself? "Creators should not be lenient with themselves." ㅤOr stare into the abyss and sink deeper? "My hands are shaking. I cannot breathe fresh air." ㅤExplore the depths of consciousness in this visual novel with a unique interactive experience. "I think I have cancer."

Game Features:

  • Condensed Psychological Journey: "The title looks like it was written by AI." ㅤAbout 0.5-1h of playtime

  • Retro Lo-Fi Aesthetics: Uses a visual style combining lo-fi filters, pixelation, and CRT processing. A depressing and lonely conscious space.

  • Smooth and Intuitive Interaction: The controls are simple but meaningful; your actions are not as simple as they seem.

  • Intertwining Reality and Fiction: Experience an inner world teetering on the edge of collapse, and try to explore the depths of the character's consciousness.


"I am going to delete all of this and rewrite it."

"I feel sick."

data.short_description: A writer is trying to finish his "perfect work," but things keep getting in his way. He is poor and full of anxiety. In this retro lo-fi visual novel, fix the problems with point-and-click, explore the depths of consciousness. Forgive yourself? or stare into the dark and fall deeper? It's up to you.
data.supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
